notes: Built from the 1100 map, adjusted to 1066.
Anatolia was still Byzantine before Manzikert (1071).
No crusader states yet; Palestine and Damascus were Fatimid.
Al-Andalus was divided into taifa kingdoms before the Almoravids crossed (1086).
The Almoravids held only southern Morocco and the Sahara.
Most of Sicily was still Muslim; the Norman conquest ran 1061–1091.
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
The County of Edessa was founded only in 1098; its pieces on this map are Byzantine.
The Principality of Antioch was founded only in 1098; its pieces on this map are Byzantine.
